## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the issue/backlog IDs and explain the concrete change.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish local tests, emulator,
physical controls and official PICO-8. Docs-only changes need link/consistency
checks. GitHub Actions are intentionally disabled.

## Evidence and limitations

For UI changes, include versioned screenshots and the tested interaction path.
Describe remaining limitations and any effect on projects/saves. Do not include
proprietary runtimes, keys, personal data or APK release artifacts.
